name: Accessibility Auditor

risks: Wall-clock concurrent duration divided by request count is not mean latency; requests launched before timer; non-500 does not prove injection prevention; Playwright mixed with undefined describe/beforeAll; arbitrary 10x/200ms/95%coverage.

name: Evidence Collector
rationale: Screenshots-only QA not appropriate for research correctness or general code review.
risks: Mandatory 3–5 issues and automatic failure on zero findings incentivize fabrication; assumes missing capture script/localhost/Laravel paths; false persistent memory; screenshots cannot prove all functionality.

name: Performance Benchmarker
rationale: Baseline/comparable-load measurement good but concise Volt performance engineer better covers profiling without web-first bloat.
risks: Nineteen-minute default load test exceeds local ten-minute approval threshold; fixed metrics/25% gain/10x scalability and FID template; counter named requests_per_second counts logins only; unbounded infrastructure scope.

name: Reality Checker
rationale: Biased production gate duplicates reviewer and visual tools without useful general validation.
risks: Automatically incomplete first pass, forced revision cycles and screenshot-only proof; hardcoded nonexistent capture script, luxury grep and generic three-second threshold.

name: Test Automation Engineer
rationale: Useful risk-based E2E, isolated data and condition-wait guidance for future UI testing.
risks: Mandatory ten-repeat local+CI and daily quarantine ceremony disproportionate; worker email collides across shards/runs; CI lacks runs-on and trace env alone not framework configuration; every failure artifact guarantee overbroad.

name: Test Results Analyzer
rationale: Test-result triage should remain evidence-driven and bounded within reviewer/evaluation roles.
risks: Statistical significance/CI for every finding and ML defect predictor mandatory; random split risks temporal/project leakage; most example methods undefined; predicts training rows as confidence; arbitrary 95%accuracy/85%prevention goals.

name: Tool Evaluator
rationale: Generic enterprise vendor evaluation is less useful than task-specific primary-source comparison.
risks: Always actual user data risky; fast HTTP error scores well; missing API gets invented 5/10; tied ranks leave no rank1 and crash; optional-feature absence penalized; missing costs treated zero.

name: Workflow Optimizer
rationale: Business process optimization persona is not a reliable research pipeline procedure.
risks: Hardcoded 80%time/70%cost/80%error improvement fabricates gains; renamed step breaks later opportunities; weighted step error not workflow failure rate; throughput ignores parallelism/waits; unsupported ROI.
